free_tier.stated: $5 compute credit, valid for 14 days, added when you sign up and not renewed; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: Free plan runs two VMs and two chats at once and includes the BoxCompute agent with a daily AI allowance; the credit is for Small and Large VMs and cannot pay the Starter subscription.

per_object_cap.stated: no object unit: the offer is a VM, and files kept in Assets are up to 5 GiB each

retention.stated: A VM stops after 30 minutes idle and keeps its files; a stopped VM costs nothing, and files saved to Assets stay after a VM is deleted.

egress.terms: New VMs have outbound internet unless turned off, reaching the public internet only: private, carrier-grade NAT and link-local addresses are blocked. Nothing on the internet connects to a VM directly; a preview link opens one port at a time. Outbound SMTP on port 25 is blocked. No egress byte allowance or traffic price is published.

interface_detail: MCP server at https://mcp.boxcompute.ai/mcp for Claude, Codex, Cursor and Claude Code; an account-scoped v2 HTTP API, official SDKs and a CLI. Machine-level SSH and selected-TCP access routes are not exposed by the current SDKs.
tooling: An MCP client, the BoxCompute CLI, the @boxcompute/sdk package or direct HTTP against the v2 API; one-hour VM browser previews are previews.create and previews.close from SDK 0.4.0.
chaining: A VM runs a server or browser task billed only while it runs, and its preview link or API key hands output to an agent; Assets keeps files when the VM is deleted, so longer-lived state needs a separate storage record.

limits.value: $5 of compute credit valid 14 days, one per person; at about $0.05 an hour for Small and $0.15 for Large this is about 100 Small or 33 Large VM hours

limits_note: Free plan runs two VMs and two chats at once; a VM stops after 30 minutes idle and keeps its files; pay as you go or a paid plan raises the concurrent VM count to three or all VMs.
binding_note: The $5 credit expires after 14 days and cannot be renewed on the free plan, so the one-time credit and its validity end before the two-VM concurrency cap matters for a single agent.

identity_cost.detail: Sign up with an email, confirm the email, then choose a password; the sign-up screen shows a Turnstile verification check and no card or phone field. The app shows an invitation-only branch when signup is not open; the pricing page states no credit card is required for the free credit.

reliability_note: Free credit expires 14 days after signup and is one per person; a VM stops after 30 minutes idle, outbound SMTP port 25 is blocked, and free accounts have limits on daily AI allowance and how many chats and VMs run at once.
confidence_note: The rate, free credit, validity, concurrency and per-second prices are quoted from the vendor's own pricing page read on 2026-11-24; the egress terms are from the vendor's security page and the email gate from the quickstart and the app's sign-up script on the same day.
